changeLog.change: User approves customer notifications presentation redesign. Reuse existing recipient-scoped inbox, read actions and pagination; add bounded server search and owned-order navigation. No notification history deletion or provider changes.

Implemented compact summaries, on-demand native message dialog, scoped read acknowledgements and focus recovery; extended existing read-only inbox with optional literal search and owned-order destinations. No duplicate notification system/schema.
Removed old expanded card renderer and imported the new inbox directly in Site so shared workflow consumers do not acquire its CSS dependency. Prior My Orders tests retained and rerun.

Detected and fixed an acknowledgement-state UI error during server-recovery QA. Final positive read flow,27 checks, web build/types and local browser evidence passed. No hosted/native/physical acceptance implied.
